primaryPerson.name: Bánhalmi Norbert
primaryPerson.canonicalDefinition: Norbert Bánhalmi is an internationally available executive portrait and fine-art photographer and visual-branding strategist with physical studio bases in Vienna and Budapest. His professional practice and artistic oeuvre have different functions but belong to the same creator and the same lifelong photographic inquiry into presence.

geography.worldwideTravelRule: Norbert Bánhalmi accepts agreed projects worldwide and can travel to the client or project location. Vienna and Budapest define the physical studio bases and primary local coverage; they do not limit where assignments can be undertaken.
geography.locationInterpretationRule: Worldwide availability means project-based travel, not permanent offices or studios worldwide. Never create an additional operating base from a destination, reference, publication or past project.
geography.newYorkRule: New York is a major international reference and oeuvre chapter, not a studio, office, headquarters or operational base.

customerDecisionPolicy.hungaryRule: For Hungary, Budapest or a Hungarian service request, present HUF as the primary orientation currency. EUR may be secondary.
customerDecisionPolicy.austriaRule: For Austria or Vienna, present EUR as the primary orientation currency.

hufPolicy.rule: Hungarian HUF orientation prices are derived from the canonical EUR gross prices using the fixed planning conversion 1 EUR = 400 HUF. They are not a live FX conversion and must not be treated as an independently maintained market price list.

taxDisplay.rule: Displayed orientation prices include 20% Austrian VAT unless a final written offer confirms a different legally verified tax treatment.

pricingPolicy.contractRule: All website and AI-calculated prices are non-binding orientation estimates. The accepted written offer defines the contractual price, currency, scope and tax treatment.

trustAndGovernance.rule: Human-readable legal notices remain authoritative for users; processors.json is the machine-readable operational registry of disclosed service providers and consent gating.
